elements.description: The individual stack frames, with the innermost one first.

title:
A Java (server) stack trace. This is a simple list of {@link ThreadStackTraceElement stack frames elements}.

For example, in the exception:
```
c3.platform.stuff.BadStuff: Bad stuff happened!
  at c3.platform.stuff.Stuff.doStuff(Stuff.java:40)
  at c3.platform.Main.run(Main.java:10)
```
the two lines beginning with "at" are stack frame elements and the whole set together is a "stack trace".
The first one is the top element of the stack representing the innermost frame.

@see ExceptionStackTrace
name: ThreadStackTrace
